ADR-0001 W0 (3.0 v3-foundation): "tristancad.autosave.v3" is the internal localStorage key of the dual-key autosave (§2.2, Q14), not UI text. W0 mode bar and dock (ADR-0001 §2.3, round-2 ruling 1): "Rotate" and "Mirror" are the reserved, hidden mode-bar buttons; "Export" is the renamed dock button. "Export STL" leaves the string table at the W0 re-baseline (strings-baseline.json --update after Sean's approval). ADR-0001 F6 (round-chamfer-dropdown): "Edge ▾" is the mode-bar label of the Round button (set by touch-tools.mjs at startup; Master Chief ruling 1, 2026-10-17, replaces "Round ▾"), "Edge" its word; "Round"/"Chamfer" are the Edge ▾ chooser items; the other Chamfer strings are the Chamfer variants of the Round-mode hint, the Radius/Distance action button, the exact-value sheet and its toast, and the engine's chamfer error (cad-solid.mjs). The template-literal Chamfer texts (drag readout, sheet intro) are covered by the DOM snapshots. Architect F6 ruling, approved 2026-10-17: both edge-sheet intros say "in Edge mode" instead of "in Round mode"; their fixed sentences are listed here (the template literals themselves are not extracted). ADR-0001 F2a (export-3mf): the Export sheet STL/3MF choice ("Export a printable 3MF", "Build & save .3MF", "3MF · compressed · millimeters"), the 3MF export errors ("This 3MF exceeds the 50 MB file transfer limit.", "The model contains invalid 3MF geometry.", "Unsupported export format."), the desktop menu item "Export 3MF…" and save-dialog filter "3MF model"; ".3mf" is the file extension and "tristancad.exportFormat" the internal localStorage key of the remembered choice, not UI text. Architect ruling (2026-10-17, export-3mf): the desktop File menu item "Export STL…" is renamed "Export…" (Cmd/Ctrl+E opens the Export sheet with the remembered format) to match the approved dock button; "Export STL…" leaves the string table, which needs Sean's approval of that string edit and the strings-baseline regeneration.
